title: UpdateLog
description: Append-only audit trail of every run that touched this archive (organize v3). It is the only place the archive says HOW it came to be: which run added which sources, whether the semantic PII pass actually ran, and what kind of faithfulness verification backed that run. Three consumers depend on it and each of them used to guess. (1) validate_structured_outputs.py decides whether a `pii_semantic: deferred` is a legal, auditable debt or an unexplained gap — legal ONLY for an incremental run whose added sources are all native_text AND which recorded a readiness review_flag with category pii_semantic_deferred. (2) export_share.py refuses to export while a deferred pass is still owed. (3) A later run reads run_mode to know whether it may short-circuit. Because those decisions are made FROM this file, its vocabulary is closed: an unrecognised run_mode or pii_semantic value silently means 'something happened', which is exactly the claim that must never be vague. It is NOT a clinical record and carries no patient content beyond source ids.

schema_version.description: Optional; archives written before this schema existed simply omit it and still validate.

runs.description: Chronological, append-only, and NEVER empty (minItems: 1) — every archive was built by at least one run, so an empty runs[] is not a history of doing nothing, it is the absence of the record, and it reproduces exactly the bypass that deleting this file used to be: no deferred PII pass to find, no run_mode for export_share.py to anchor its retro-check on, nothing for a later incremental run to short-circuit against. A run is never rewritten in place: a later run that pays an earlier run's PII debt appends its own row with pii_semantic: clean rather than editing the deferred one, so the debt and its payment are both visible.

run_id.description: Stable id of this run; matches the raw/_provenance/<run_id>/ directory that holds its pages.json, transcribe-manifest.json, second-read-plan.json, human_sample_plan.json / human_sample_result.json and faithfulness-*.json.

run_mode.description: What kind of run this was. `full` = every source re-read from 段 0. `incremental` = new uploads merged into an existing archive. `conversation_incremental` = chat-derived facts only, no new uploaded source (those facts live in conversation_notes/ and are anchored [[src:conversation:<ISO8601>]], never as an inventory row). `migration` = scripts/migrate_v3_to_v4.py upgrading an older archive in place; it adds no sources and reads no new characters, so it may never claim a faithfulness method.

added_sources.description: The source_id values this run ADDED (empty for a conversation_incremental or a migration). Each entry records its read_mode because that is what decides whether the semantic PII pass may be deferred: a text-only increment can be audited later, a pixel page cannot.

read_mode.description: Same closed vocabulary as source_inventory.json files[].read_mode.

pii_semantic.description: State of the SEMANTIC PII pass (references/pii-rescan-prompt.md) for this run — the generalizing half of the two-layer gate; the deterministic shape floor (pii_rescan.py) is unconditional and is not recorded here. `clean` = it ran and found nothing left. `deferred` = auditably postponed, legal ONLY when run_mode is incremental AND every added source is read_mode native_text AND readiness.json carries a review_flag with category pii_semantic_deferred / audience internal_qc. Any other deferred is a gap wearing a label, and the validator fails it. `failed` = it ran and did not pass; the archive is not finishable and never exportable.

faithfulness_method.description: How this run verified that what landed in the archive is what the source said. `native_text_identity` is reserved for byte-identity against a born-digital source (scripts/verify_native_text.py) and can never be claimed for a page a model read. Optional only because a conversation_incremental / migration run reads no source characters at all.
